integration_grid.method: Saved 1 ms force grid plus linear interpolation at exact frozen nominal boundaries. No extrapolation beyond this declared source-rounding tolerance. RMS/correlation use time integrals to avoid phase-dependent sample-count weighting.

methodology.primary: Exactly three preselected nominal complete cycles after one excluded nominal startup cycle for each subject; cycle boundaries come from measured GRF, never simulated FSM event counts.
methodology.acquisition: Saved native 1 ms STO grids, checked against captured integration_dt. Exact nominal endpoints are interpolated inside observed support, allowing 10 ns timestamp coincidence for STO 8-decimal serialization only; no extrapolation beyond that declared rounding allowance.
methodology.force_normalization: Fy/BW with frozen subject model mass times9.80665. Compare simulation/measurement impulse ratio per-cycle and ratio of summed impulses; BW normalization is postprocessing only.
methodology.phase_waveform_csv: 1001 points per nominal cycle, phase0..1, derived from native samples for shape visualization only; physical impulse/RMS metrics retain native 1 ms grids.
methodology.event_semantics: Saved binary geometryFSM onset, confirmed and delivered versus measured GRF events are separate from retained actor events and raw vertical-force 20 N crossings. Missing and extra events are retained.
methodology.tolerance_scope: Inherited diagnostic references, not newly adopted subject acceptance gates.
methodology.interruptions: Frozen requested duration and cycle boundaries remain unchanged. Any unavailable full primary cycle is reported unavailable and the3-cycle aggregate is withheld; observed last sample never becomes a replacement nominal end.

limitations: This is an IK-driven bank-control comparison, not a learned-policy transfer qualification.
Subject changes include anatomical model, IK and right measured loading, so deviations do not isolate one contact-profile parameter or mechanism.
Startup and remaining 9 s tail are secondary; full episode duration completion is distinct from three-cycle observation and physiological validity.

An HS at the initial reset is initialization, not an expected new streamed transition. Startup matching retains this fact as an explicit missing/reference distinction rather than silently changing primary windows.
Nominal GRF threshold events are production-derived references rather than manual physiological annotations.
Actor-cycle validity and generic IK tracking criteria are diagnostics and do not create new AB06/AB07 acceptance gates.
